{"notes": "Visit 1, left at 0:30. The table is still empty: no dominoes placed and nothing connected to the start yet. This is early, so nothing to judge on output.

Maya: Proposed the fish at 0:00 with a clear design (big body, split at nose into top and bottom lines, rounded tail at right). Assigned Tom the top line, Priya the bottom line and Leo the tail, and is sketching the plan. Good early leadership and clarity. Watch: does she stay in sketching mode too long while the clock runs? Has she placed anything? Does she check the others are on board?

Tom: Accepted the fish and claimed the top line. Asked Maya for a sketch with the nose start at the left and both lines leaving it going right. This is useful collaboration thinking, since only what connects to the start falls. He has not placed anything yet. Watch whether he starts building or waits for the sketch.

Priya: Said nothing while I was there. Assigned the bottom line but gave no acknowledgement. No evidence either way. Check on next visit that she knows her role and has started.

Leo: Also silent. Assigned the tail but no acknowledgement. Same: no evidence yet. Check he's engaged and that the tail will connect to the body.

Team risk: the plan depends on one sketch and one start point at the nose. Tom's point about connection to the start is the key thing to watch. Ask Priya and Leo privately later how they felt about their assignments. I don't know who places which domino, so don't credit anyone for placement without seeing it or hearing about it."}
